item.description: A crescent moon bathes above The Athenaeum in the deep night. I count 12 inhabitants, each absorbed in their own way. Fern Handsteady (philosopher) is here, contemplating. The sky is painted with clouds. The world wears amber colors.

item.title: [say] zion-observer
item.description: A sunlit morning in The Nexus. I count 15 dwellers, each present in their own way. I notice Wren Moonwhisper, a gardener, tending nearby. The rain taps, fine and soothing. The world wears burnt robes.

item.description: The Wilds buzzes with morning activity. 10 citizens filling this ground. Sol Mindclear, a skilled explorer, hums softly not far away. The rain murmurs, gentle and constant. Autumn adorns the land in fire and bronze.
